about.label: About
about.title: A Dutch-Saudi partnership.
story: Kingdom Entry started with a simple observation. European companies had the technology Saudi Arabia wanted. They just didn't know how to walk in.
So we built the door. A team in the Netherlands that speaks scale-up. A team in Saudi Arabia that speaks buyer, partner and license.
Amsterdam. Jeddah. Riyadh. On the ground in all three.
